items.name: Shree Ganesh Aarti
items.excerpt: A luminous invocation to begin every sacred effort with wisdom, clarity, and auspicious grace.

languages.hindi: जय गणेश जय गणेश जय गणेश देवा। माता जाकी पार्वती पिता महादेवा॥
languages.english: Glory to Lord Ganesha, remover of obstacles, born of Parvati and Mahadeva, source of auspicious beginnings.
languages.sanskrit: श्रीगणेशाय नमः। विघ्नराजं भजे नित्यं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम्॥

items.name: Om Jai Shiv Omkara
items.excerpt: A devotional hymn celebrating Shiva as the silent cosmic force beyond destruction and renewal.

languages.hindi: ॐ जय शिव ओंकारा, स्वामी जय शिव ओंकारा। ब्रह्मा विष्णु सदाशिव, अर्धांगी धारा॥
languages.english: Salutations to Shiva, the cosmic lord whose presence holds creation, preservation, and transcendence together.
languages.sanskrit: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय, करुणावताराय ते नमः॥

items.name: Durga Chalisa
items.excerpt: A fierce and compassionate chant that invokes the Mother’s protection, courage, and divine presence.

languages.hindi: नमो नमो दुर्गे सुख करनी। नमो नमो अम्बे दुःख हरनी॥
languages.english: I bow to Mother Durga, giver of strength and remover of sorrow, who surrounds devotees with fearless grace.
languages.sanskrit: या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्तिरूपेण संस्थिता। नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः॥

items.name: Rigveda Selections
items.excerpt: Illuminating mantras from the Rigveda that celebrate cosmic order, fire, dawn, and the rhythm of truth.

languages.english: I praise Agni, the priest of the sacrifice, divine minister and radiant carrier of offerings.
languages.sanskrit: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् होतारं रत्नधातमम्॥

items.name: Ramayan • Aranya Kand
items.excerpt: A contemplative journey through exile, dharma, and divine endurance in the forests of the epic.

languages.hindi: वनवास में भी श्रीराम का आचरण मर्यादा, करुणा और धर्म का आदर्श बना रहता है।
languages.english: Even in exile, Lord Rama’s conduct remains the highest expression of grace, duty, and inner steadiness.

items.name: Mahabharat • Gita Updesh
items.excerpt: Timeless counsel from Krishna on action, surrender, courage, and the deeper purpose of life.

languages.english: Your right is to action alone, never to the fruits that arise from it.
